sentences.text: Leyton Orient Football Club -LSB- ˌleɪtən_ˈɔəriənt -RSB- is a professional football club in Leyton , London , England .	football	Association football	Leyton	Leyton	London	London

They play in the National League , the fifth tier of the English football league system , following relegation from the Football League in the 2016-17 season .	football	Association football	National League	National League (division)	English football league system	English football league system	Football League	English Football League	2016-17 season	2016-17 EFL League Two
They are known to their fans as the Os , and club 's home colours are all red .
Leyton Orient have spent one season in the top flight of English football , in 1962 -- 63 .	football	Association football	Leyton	Leyton

In 1978 , they reached the semi-finals of the FA Cup for the only time in their history , under the management of Jimmy Bloomfield .	1978	1978 in association football	FA Cup	FA Cup	Jimmy Bloomfield	Jimmy Bloomfield

Between October 1993 and September 1995 , Orient did not win a single away game in the league , leaving them bottom of Division Two in 1994 -- 95 .	1993	1993 in association football	Division Two	EFL League One	1995	1995 in football (soccer)

Leyton Orient 's home ground Brisbane Road is officially known as the Matchroom Stadium after former club chairman Barry Hearn 's sports promotion company .	Brisbane Road	Brisbane Road	Leyton	Leyton	Barry Hearn	Barry Hearn

Hearn became chairman in 1995 after the club was put on sale for # 5 by then-chairman Tony Wood , a period covered by the television documentary Orient : Club for a Fiver , made by production company Open Media for Channel 4 .	1995	1995 in football (soccer)	Open Media	Open Media	Channel 4	Channel 4
In 2014 , Hearn sold the club to Italian businessman Francesco Becchetti , who achieved two relegations in three years under 11 managers .
Leyton Orient finished seventh , one place away from the playoff positions , in both the 2010 -- 11 and 2012 -- 13 seasons .	Leyton	Leyton

In the 2013 -- 14 season , Orient lost the League One Play-Off final at Wembley to Rotherham United and in 2015 were relegated to League Two .	Wembley	Wembley Stadium	Rotherham United	Rotherham United

On 22 April 2017 , Orient were relegated to the National League , ending their 112 year stay in the Football League .	National League	National League (division)	Football League	English Football League
